Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
01.10.2024
Ad-32
Court No.29
Tn
 Crm (A) 3506 of 2024
 In re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the
 Code of Criminal Procedure/under Section 482 of the Bharatiya
 Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with
 Nakashipara Police Station Case No. 601 of 2024 dated
 02.07.2024 under Secretions 498A/406/324/307/34 of the Ipc
 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
 And
 In the matter of: Sentu Aman Biswas @ Santu Biswas and
 others
 - petitioners
 Mr. Prabir Majumdar
 .... for the petitioners
 Ms. Baishali Basu,
 Ms. Sufi Kamal
 ....for the State
 1.

On an undertaking that the petitioners shall return the stridhan in presence of the victim before the
Investigating Officer (Io)
, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners for the time being.
2. The matter is adjourned till 7th October, 2024.
3. The IO shall file a report on the adjourned date.
4. A copy of this application shall also be served upon the opposite party no.2 through the IO.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
